headline: Ashiana Housing Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates — Ashiana Housing Limited has informed the Exchange that the company has paid INR 34,28,27,056/- (Indian Rupees Thirty-Four Crores Twenty-Eight Lakhs Twenty-Seven Thousand Fifty-Six Only) to ICICI Prudential Regular Savings…
detail: General Updates — Ashiana Housing Limited has informed the Exchange that the company has paid INR 34,28,27,056/- (Indian Rupees Thirty-Four Crores Twenty-Eight Lakhs Twenty-Seven Thousand Fifty-Six Only) to ICICI Prudential Regular Savings Fund and ICICI Prudential Credit Risk Fund on 12th May 2026 against interest payment and partial redemption of Secured Non- Convertible Debentures (NCDs) listed on BSE Ltd, details of which are mentioned in the pdf attached
